cases.message:
Here are the main data areas found in the local IPEDS files:

**Survey: Student Financial Aid**

Reporting periods vary by data area; exact coverage is in Definitions & sources.

- **Average net price by aid group.** Explore average net price for full-time, first-time undergraduates who got grant aid or federal aid. Public institutions cover in-district or in-state rate payers.
- **Financial aid cohort share.** A separate later table describes first-time full-time undergraduates as a percent of all undergraduates in the financial aid cohort.

**Survey: Cost**

Reporting periods: Academic year 2024-25.

- **Total cost of attendance estimates.** Derived totals for full-time, first-time degree-seeking undergraduates, by residency and housing plan, for institutions charging by academic year.
- **Published charges and housing.** Look at application fees, tuition and required fees, food and housing for undergraduate and graduate students, plus cost of attendance estimates.

**Survey: Finance**

Reporting periods: Fiscal year 2015 through Fiscal year 2024.

- **Public institution finances.** Institution-level revenues, expenditures, assets and liabilities for public institutions using governmental accounting standards. This gives context on costs, not family payments.

**Survey: Institutional Characteristics**

Reporting periods vary by data area; exact coverage is in Definitions & sources.

- **Offerings, services and programs.** Program and award offerings, control, affiliation and special learning opportunities, including veteran support services where reported.
- **Branch campus locations.** Branch locations that main campuses chose to list, with addresses, links including net price calculators, and cost of attendance data where applicable.
- **Institution directory details.** Names, addresses and web links, including financial aid offices and net price calculators, plus control, level and degree offered.

This is a bounded search of the local IPEDS files, not a complete inventory. Populations, coverage and definitions vary by measure and year; availability does not guarantee reported values for every institution. Some source series remain separate because their definitions or structures differ. Some matched records come from a provisional release; see source details. Your wording can have more than one meaning; these data areas are not treated as equivalent.

Tell me the institution, measure and years you would like to explore.

cases.message:
Here are the main data areas found in the local IPEDS files:

**Survey: Human Resources**

Reporting periods: Fall 2015 through Fall 2024.

- **Average salaries for instructional staff.** Explore average pay for full-time, nonmedical instructional staff, equated to 9-month contracts, by academic rank, alongside staff counts by occupational category.

**Survey: Institutional Characteristics**

Reporting periods: Academic year 2015-16 through Academic year 2024-25.

- **Teacher certification and program offerings.** This covers program types and special learning opportunities, including whether an institution is state-approved to certify teachers. It does not describe pay.

**Survey: Student Financial Aid**

Reporting periods vary by data area; exact coverage is in Definitions & sources.

- **Net price and aid, earlier years.** Average net price for full-time, first-time degree or certificate-seeking undergraduates with grant aid or federal aid. Public institutions include only in-state or in-district payers.
- **First-time share of undergraduates.** A financial aid cohort measure showing full-time, first-time degree or certificate-seeking students as a percent of all undergraduates.

**Survey: Cost**

Reporting periods: Academic year 2024-25.

- **Cost of attendance and net price.** Total cost of attendance and average net price for full-time, first-time degree or certificate-seeking undergraduates awarded grant or federal aid.
- **Financial aid and tuition-rate counts.** Aid data behind net price for full-time, first-time undergraduates, including counts and percentages paying in-district or in-state tuition in the fall cohort.

**Survey: Academic Libraries**

Reporting periods: 2015-16; 2016-17; 2017-18; 2019-20; Fiscal year 2020; Fiscal year 2021; Fiscal year 2022; Fiscal year 2023; Fiscal year 2024.

- **Library collections and services.** Library characteristics, collections, expenditures and services for degree-granting institutions. Library staff counts appear in later years. Not teacher pay.
- **Library collection and expense indicators.** Derived library measures: percent distribution of collections by material type, expenses by function, and expenditures per full-time-equivalent enrollment.

This is a bounded search of the local IPEDS files, not a complete inventory. cases.message:
Here are the main data areas found in the local IPEDS files:

**Survey: Graduation Rates**

Reporting periods vary by data area; exact coverage is in Definitions & sources.

- **Completion and transfer-out, 4-year and 2-year.** Explore full-time, first-time student groups who finished within 150% of normal time or transferred out, by gender and race/ethnicity where reported.
- **Less-than-2-year completion and transfers.** See completion, transfer-out, exclusions and still-enrolled counts for full-time, first-time students at less-than-2-year institutions.
- **Pell and Stafford loan recipient groups.** Explore completion for students who received Pell grants, subsidized Stafford loans without Pell, or neither, within 150% of normal time.
- **Ready-made graduation and transfer-out rates.** Derived graduation rates within 150% of normal time, including transfer-out rates, by race/ethnicity and gender for selected cohorts.

**Survey: Outcome Measures**

Reporting periods vary by data area; exact coverage is in Definitions & sources.

- **Six- and eight-year outcomes, earlier cohorts.** Award and enrollment results for full-time and part-time, first-time and non-first-time entering undergraduates at degree-granting institutions, including those enrolled elsewhere.
- **Six- and eight-year outcomes, later cohorts.** Same award and enrollment outcomes for later entering undergraduate cohorts at degree-granting institutions, split by Pell and non-Pell subcohorts.

**Survey: Fall Enrollment**

cases.message:
Here are the main data areas found in the local IPEDS files:

**Survey: Cost**

Reporting periods: Academic year 2024-25.

- **Charges, fees, housing and food.** Explore application fees, tuition and required fees, food and housing for undergraduate and graduate students. Cost of attendance estimates cover first-time, full-time undergraduates.
- **Total cost of attendance summaries.** Derived totals cover full-time, first-time degree-seeking undergraduates by residency and housing plan. They apply to institutions that charge by academic year.

**Survey: Finance**

Reporting periods: Fiscal year 2015 through Fiscal year 2024.

- **Public college tuition revenue and discounts.** For public institutions using government accounting standards, see tuition and fee revenue after discounts, plus scholarship discounts, including Pell and other federal grants.

**Survey: Institutional Characteristics**

Reporting periods vary by data area; exact coverage is in Definitions & sources.

- **Academic-year tuition and required fees.** Look at average tuition and required fees for full-time undergraduate and graduate students, and per-credit charges for part-time students, where reported.
- **Charges for vocational programs.** For institutions pricing by program length, find tuition and fees for the largest program and some additional programs.
- **Branch campus cost information.** Branch locations listed on College Navigator include cost of attendance, including tuition and fees, where they enroll full-time, first-time undergraduates. The list is not comprehensive.
- **Directory with tuition policy links.** Institution directory details include names, addresses and web links. A veterans and servicemembers tuition policy web address appears among the fields.
- **Program and institution context.** Background on program and award offerings, control, affiliation and special learning opportunities. It has no tuition amounts in the supplied description.

This is a bounded search of the local IPEDS files, not a complete inventory. Populations, coverage and definitions vary by measure and year; availability does not guarantee reported values for every institution. Some matched records come from a provisional release; see source details. Your wording can have more than one meaning; these data areas are not treated as equivalent.

Tell me the institution, measure and years you would like to explore.
